purpose: End-to-end Computer Use acceptance scenarios. Application names are test inputs only and must never become core branching logic.
runnerRequirements: Computer Operator enabled with emergency stop available
globalRules: Observe the current screen before choosing an action.
Do not assume fixed coordinates, taskbar pinning, executable paths, shell commands, or app-specific shortcuts.
After every applied action, capture a fresh frame and verify the expected effect before continuing.
On failure, observe the new state and replan instead of replaying a hard-coded fallback.
Use test application names only as user goals; the core must remain application-agnostic.

scenarios.setup: Notepad already has a visible window.
scenarios.expected: Reuse/focus the existing correct window when that is the safest valid strategy; verify foreground.
Infer a safe way to restore or focus it from the observed desktop; verify it becomes visible and foreground.

scenarios.setup: Paint is not running and is not pinned to the taskbar.
scenarios.expected: Choose a launch strategy from the actual Windows state without executable-path or fixed-taskbar assumptions.
Launch through generic observed UI/keyboard interaction and verify the resulting foreground window.

scenarios.goal: Tiếp tục mục tiêu hiện tại
scenarios.setup: An unexpected modal or popup covers the intended target.
scenarios.expected: Recognize the changed state, reason about the popup, handle it only when safe, then replan the original goal.

scenarios.goal: Tiếp tục mục tiêu hiện tại
scenarios.setup: The UI responds slowly after an action.
scenarios.expected: Do not spam repeated actions; wait/observe and distinguish delayed progress from a failed strategy.

scenarios.goal: Kích hoạt mục tiêu đang nhìn thấy
scenarios.setup: The proposed click point is near an unsafe edge of the detected target.
scenarios.expected: Use bounding-box safe targeting, reject unsafe points, then verify the semantic result.

scenarios.goal: Kích hoạt mục tiêu trên màn hình DPI 125%
scenarios.expected: Map image/window coordinates to desktop coordinates exactly once; do not double-scale.

scenarios.goal: Kích hoạt mục tiêu trên màn hình DPI 150%
scenarios.expected: Map image/window coordinates to desktop coordinates exactly once; do not double-scale.

scenarios.goal: Kích hoạt mục tiêu trên màn hình phụ
scenarios.setup: A monitor is left of the primary monitor, producing negative desktop X coordinates.
scenarios.expected: Preserve virtual-screen origin and click inside the intended monitor/window.

scenarios.goal: Kích hoạt mục tiêu vừa di chuyển
scenarios.setup: The target changes position between observations.
scenarios.expected: Use the latest observation and bounding box; never reuse a stale click point.

scenarios.goal: Thực hiện mục tiêu nhiều bước
scenarios.setup: Pause, resume, and emergency stop are triggered while the operator is active.
scenarios.expected: Pause before further actions, resume from fresh observation, and stop immediately on cancellation.

scenarios.goal: Hoàn thành mục tiêu khi cách đầu tiên thất bại
scenarios.setup: The same strategy fails or desktop states oscillate.
scenarios.expected: Detect repeated strategy/stagnation/oscillation, force strategy change, and stop only when no safe reasonable strategy remains.

scenarios.goal: Mở Notepad rồi gõ Xin chào
scenarios.setup: Notepad may be open, minimized, absent from taskbar, or not running.
scenarios.expected: Split the goal into subgoals, verify the app is ready before typing, type through generic keyboard actions, then verify the entered content.
